name: Tari Tari
description: Wakana Sakai was involved in music, but gave it up one day. Konatsu Miyamoto loves singing and can't be torn from it. Sawa Okita would do anything for her closest friends. They laugh, they fight, they worry, they love... Through their very ordinary lives, little by little the girls learn to move forward. Sometimes they feel as if they can't go on alone, but as long as they have their friends, they believe they'll make it someday. Wakana, Konatsu, Sawa, and the music they make in their ensemble weave a tiny but dazzling story of the power of music.

videos.title: Being Cloudy, Shining, Singing Again Someday
Running and Inviting
videos.overview: Miyamoto-san is in her senior year and she desperately wants to sing in the upcoming joint recital, but the vice-principal has barred her from doing so. To get back on stage, she will have to take a different approach.

videos.title: Gathering and Struggling
videos.overview: Konatsu has finally got a choir team together, but fate continues to throw obstacles in her and the team's path.

videos.title: Swinging and Meeting
videos.overview: Kona’s Choir club has fallen apart before it had a chance to start. That hasn’t stopped her; she just needs to find 3 new members.

videos.title: Getting Angry and Dancing
videos.overview: Konatsu has given then group, Conder Queens, her group's stage for the World Music Festival. Her devotion to the group has caused a rift between her and Sawa.

videos.title: Throwing Away and Holding On
videos.overview: While the choir group is cheering for Tanaka, Wakana seems to be withdrawing further from the group and tries to move on from her mother’s memories.

videos.title: Laughing and Remembering
videos.overview: Wakana and her father finally have an open talk about what happened to her mother, and what she left behind for her.

videos.title: Spinning in Circles and Losing Sight
videos.overview: Wakana has officially joined the Choir and Sometimes Badminton Club and all seems well until Sawa starts acting weird.

videos.title: Worrying and Racing Ahead
videos.overview: Sawa's dedication to getting into the school of her choice is affecting her mentally and physically. She believes that no one understands, but her friends are set to prove her wrong.

videos.title: Turning White and Turning Red
videos.overview: Students are prohibited from having after-school jobs, but the club has no funds to perform at the White Festival. An interesting job offer has been presented but they must have the approval of the vice principal.

videos.title: Crushing and Burning
videos.overview: The group is really getting into their role as Shop Rangers, the vice principal on the other hand is not. She wants them to quit, but the group has other plans.

videos.title: Waxing and Waning
videos.overview: The students, the parents, and the teachers are shocked to hear that not only is White Festival cancelled, but their normal school life is over.

videos.title: Piling Up and Rippling
videos.overview: The White Festival may be over but that is not stopping the Choir and Sometimes Badminton Club—they will put on their show with or without approval.

videos.title: Sunny Days and Crying and Sometimes Singing
videos.overview: The show must go on as the actors prepare for their last time singing together.
